Hi Dr. Watanabe,

I'm Anirudh Bagla, a student at Harvard Business School. 

My co-founder and I are exploring a way for independent practices like Watanabe Pediatrics to give GLP-1 patients complete care, side-effect management, nutrition and exercise, through a shared team of nutritionists and coaches, with the insurance billing handled. Large health systems already do this; we want to know if it would work for independent practices.

We're not selling anything. Would you have 30 minutes on Thu 10/22 2:00pm or Mon 10/26 10:00am, by phone or in person at your practice?

Thank you,
